name: hospital-management-system
description: CareeAi — Smart Hospital Queue & Management System

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npx concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.start: npm run build:shared && npx concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix shared && tsc -p backend/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p frontend/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build:backend && node tests/field-types.test.js && node tests/field-normalization.test.js && node tests/chat-engine.test.js && node tests/billing.test.js && node tests/lab-pdf.test.js && node tests/facility-landing.test.js && node tests/daily-reset.test.js && node tests/tenant-guard.test.js && node tests/env-guard.test.js && node tests/uploads.test.js && node tests/r2.test.js && node tests/facility-auth.test.js && node tests/person-login.test.js
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
